text:
Ava: Quick sync — proposing a small UX pass on the trace viewer flamegraph: add a visible focus ring for nodes, clarify keyboard nav order, and surface the export action in the node/context menu. Thoughts? cc @Ravi @Sam :memo:
Ravi: Nice. My primary concern is tab order. Should timeline scrub be before node details or after? Users often want to scrub first.
Sam: Hmm. For screen readers it's helpful to expose node details immediately. Suggest: node -> details panel -> timeline -> export. That keeps semantic context.
Marta: Accessibility checklist: aria-label on flame nodes, role=button for clickable spans, aria-live region for selection changes. Also ensure focus is not lost when export dialog opens.
Olivia: Copy nit: current export button says "Export trace" — recommend more explicit: "Download trace snapshot (.json)" or list formats: \'Download trace (.json)\', \'Export spans (.csv)\'.
Ava: Draft copy options to choose from:
- "Download trace snapshot (.json)"
- "Export span list (.csv)"
- "Copy correlation ID" (clipboard) :clipboard: (with success toast)
Sam: For the copy flow, add an aria-live announcement and a small tooltip: "Correlation ID copied" (role/status). Prevent duplicate focus shift.
Ava: tiny CSS proposal for focus ring (w/ high contrast):
```css
.flame-node:focus { outline: 3px solid #0055aa; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,85,170,0.12); }
```
Ravi: Good pick on color — #0055aa has better contrast on white. Also consider dark mode token.
Marta: Keyboard shortcuts idea: when a node is focused: "c" = copy corr id, "e" = open export menu. Need a conflict matrix with global shortcuts.
Sam: I'll add the shortcuts behind a feature flag and ensure focus return after dialogs. Also will add UA fallbacks for older browsers.
Olivia: Microcopy tweak suggestion: change "This correlation ID links related requests" -> "Links related requests" to keep toast short.
Ava: Can we run a small a/b test for updated copy + focus ring? 25% rollout maybe.
Ravi: Yes, product can do 25% rollout. Sam — can you add a quick metric to track CTR on export and copy?
Sam: Yep, will add events: trace_export_click, span_csv_export, corrid_copy.
deploy-bot: FYI: design-prototypes/trace-flamegraph-v2 pushed to staging (build #2213). :sparkles:
Ava: Great — I'll update the Figma specs with the focus order, aria attributes, and the final copy. Please review in the file and drop any final nits. :eyes:
